data.prediction: In a vanilla sandbox setup, a unit visible before entry will no longer be visible/selectable after crossing into a payload conveyor, without emerging normally.
data.observation: A payload conveyor was placed and visibly confirmed in a sandbox world, but no controllable or produced ground unit could be obtained in the available session; therefore an entry event could not be performed.

data.summary: Could not reproduce or disprove the reported disappearance because the required unit-entry transition was not achieved. A vanilla sandbox world was launched, the Units build category was opened, and a Payload Conveyor was selected and placed (its visible tooltip and conveyor sprite confirmed it). Attempts to create a Ground Factory test source produced only unconstructed placement ghosts because the setup lacked delivery/construction capability, and no existing controllable ground unit was available. Thus no unit entered the conveyor.
